correctness.rationale: For Bring’s genus-four complex curve, original homology generators a,b reduced mod2 are conjugate by the displayed invertible T to the four-dimensional even-subset representation W of S5; independently multiplied both 4x4 intertwining equalities for the 5-cycle and transposition. Alternating nondegenerate dot pairing W×W identifies the symplectic dual with W, giving all 256 theta characteristics as W⊕W with q(A,B)=|A∩B| mod2 based at unique invariant even characteristic. End_S5(W)=F2 follows from stabilizer of a 2-subset and its spanning orbit; hence orthogonal commutant on W⊕W is GL2(F2)=S3. S5 pairs of even subsets classified by (|A|,|B|,|A∩B|) yield 14 orbits: even 1 and 3 each of sizes 5,10,30; odd three of size20 and one of size60. The commuting S3 permutes each repeated triple, fixing singleton orbits. Independent combinatorial enumeration reproduces 136 even+120 odd spin characteristics, all orbit sizes and six S3 bundles. NOT an assertion of automorphisms of the curve or principally polarized Jacobian.
